chapters.title: Last Tour Before Closing
chapters.dramatic_job: Turn 43 episodes into one causal and emotionally honest museum tour
chapters.entering_state: Faction labels and machine spectacle dominate the exhibits
chapters.exit_change: The docents and player leave with a relationship-centered causal map
chapters.opening_hook: The last tour begins with twenty minutes on the clock
chapters.closing_pull: The HOME punch asks what the next tour should notice

nodes.goal: RX and Zaku must establish a fair causal tour and explain why Amuro enters Gundam
nodes.pressure: Forty-three episodes must fit before the museum closes without reducing mass death to faction trivia
nodes.turn: The first Gundam victory is reframed as the beginning of a refugee story
nodes.decision: The docents dim the victory lamp and keep the ruined colony visible
nodes.consequence: White Base, not the machine alone, becomes the tour's narrative spine
nodes.entering_state: The museum labels invite a simple hero-versus-villain reading
nodes.exit_state: The docents commit to witness, causality, and civilian consequence

nodes.goal: Explain how refugees become a crew and how Char turns friendship into revenge
nodes.pressure: Federation protocol, exhaustion, reentry, and Zeon pursuit all narrow White Base's choices
nodes.turn: Char feeds Garma false guidance and Gihren turns the resulting death into propaganda
nodes.decision: The tour follows White Base closely enough to show authority as frightened improvisation
nodes.consequence: Ramba Ral inherits both a military hunt and a chain of private grief
nodes.entering_state: White Base is an accidental transport full of civilians and prototypes
nodes.exit_state: The crew is becoming a family while Char's revenge begins reshaping Zeon command

nodes.goal: Show Amuro's growth without pretending that victory protects the people around him
nodes.pressure: Family estrangement, desertion, Ral's experience, command strain, and Zeon's nuclear threat converge
nodes.turn: Ryu and Matilda die while White Base becomes strategically indispensable
nodes.decision: Amuro returns to the crew and stops M'Quve's nuclear strike
nodes.consequence: The Federation breaks Zeon's Earth foothold, but victory is experienced as names on glass
nodes.entering_state: Amuro believes one gifted pilot can solve the mine and his own exhaustion
nodes.exit_state: He understands that courage, command, and victory still accumulate human cost

rhythm.entry_hook: Amuro believes he can solve the mine alone

nodes.goal: Connect Kai's return, Jaburo's institutional absorption, and Amuro's accelerating ability
nodes.pressure: Miharu's poverty, Char's return, Federation utility, Tem Ray's damage, and neutral-space attacks deny easy safety
nodes.turn: Kai freely returns while the Federation converts White Base into a decoy
nodes.decision: The docents replace a spy token with an empty chair and two lunch tins
nodes.consequence: White Base becomes a chosen home even as its people are made more useful to the war
nodes.entering_state: Detachment and arrival at Jaburo still look like possible exits
nodes.exit_state: Choice creates belonging; formal safety creates new military exposure

rhythm.reader_effect: Home and institutional use become simultaneous

nodes.goal: Explain the Newtype possibility through people before institutions claim it as a weapon
nodes.pressure: Solomon, Sleggar's sacrifice, Char's Deikun identity, and organized Newtype warfare close every peaceful opening
nodes.turn: Amuro and Lalah understand one another across enemy lines, then Lalah dies protecting Char
nodes.decision: Char and Amuro convert shared grief into renewed rivalry
nodes.consequence: The story approaches its final battle with connection recognized but militarily unusable
nodes.entering_state: Amuro's growing awareness could still widen empathy
nodes.exit_state: The war has turned that awareness into targeting and blame

rhythm.reader_effect: Awe turns to grief and blame

nodes.goal: Complete the Zabi collapse, final duel, White Base escape, and thematic return home
nodes.pressure: Solar Ray destroys peace and fleets; the Zabis assassinate one another; Gundam, Zeong, and White Base are lost
nodes.turn: Amuro guides the crew out and their voices guide him back
nodes.decision: The docents replace HERO and VILLAIN with WITNESS and wait for everyone to leave together
nodes.consequence: The machines end, the war soon ends, and the relationships survive
nodes.entering_state: Power appears concentrated in superweapons, fortresses, and command families
nodes.exit_state: The decisive system is people recognizing and guiding one another across wreckage

rhythm.reader_effect: Earned relief without a clean-war verdict

setup_payoff_paths.changed_meaning: The clock waits at zero until everyone leaves together
The final punch is HOME rather than a faction or weapon
Both labels are replaced by a shared WITNESS badge
The family weaponizes itself until the board pulls apart
Kai's voluntary return makes White Base a home rather than only an assignment
Both sides answer wider perception by building organized Newtype warfare
Mutual guidance at Escape realizes connection outside targeting
The final witness label preserves the people hidden beneath campaign outcomes

relationships.surface_dynamic: Opposing mobile-suit silhouettes sharing one museum shift
relationships.buried_need: Each needs the other's lens to avoid spectacle or footnote paralysis
relationships.pressure_point: The closing clock rewards speed while the history demands care
relationships.visible_change: They remove HERO and VILLAIN and share WITNESS
relationships.status_game: RX controls tour momentum; Zaku can stop the lamp or correct the label
relationships.shared_joke: The museum's labels and bureaucracy are less prepared than either docent
relationships.secret_tenderness: Each protects the human cost the other's silhouette could obscure
relationships.conversation_game: One states the clean version; the other reveals the cost or causal exception

status_flips.change: Zaku dims the victory lamp and sets the ethical tour rule
RX and Zaku surrender opposing badges together
